description: This file is a shell script that contains a comprehensive set of test cases for verifying the behavior of Git's promisor remote capabilities, including setup, configuration, cloning, and fetching scenarios involving large object promisor logic.

methods.name: check_missing_objects
methods.description: Checks for missing objects in a repository against expected OIDs.

methods.name: initialize_server
methods.description: Reinitializes the server repository with specified missing objects for testing.

methods.name: copy_to_lop
methods.description: Copies objects from the server repository to the lop (Large Object Promisor) repository.
